9. REMOVE COMBINATION METER
(a) Remove the four screws.
(b) Disconnect the connectors and remove the meter.

10. REMOVE CONSOLE BOX
(a) Remove the console box carpet and the coin box.
(b) Remove the eight screws and the cup holder.
(c) Disconnect the connectors and remove the console box.

11. REMOVE HEATER CONTROL
(a) Remove the three screws.
(b) Disconnect the connectors and remove the heater control.

12. REMOVE RADIO AND STEREO
(a) Remove the four screws.
(b) Disconnect the connectors and radio antenna cable.
(c) Remove the radio and stereo.

13. REMOVE INSTRUMENT PANEL NO.2 UNDER COVER
Remove the three screws and cover.

14. REMOVE GLOVE COMPARTMENT DOOR
Remove the two screws and door.
